messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT triggered: GPU-CAPACITY-EXHAUSTION in us-west-2 (severity: P1) - queue growth detected, autoscaler failing. Pager oncall: @oncall-alice :rotating_light:

oncall-alice: ack. seeing spike in gpu-request-queue metrics, +820 pending tokens over last 5m. routing degraded. Investigating.

infra-ben: jumping in. any errors from cluster-autoscaler?

oncall-alice: grabbing logs now. cluster-autoscaler shows repeated failures adding nodes to nodegroup gpu-pool-3: AddNode failed: LaunchTemplateNotPermitted: iam:PassRole missing. stacktrace below.

oncall-alice: ```
I0723 21:06:12.345678 1 scale_up.go:432] NodeGroup gpu-pool-3: attempt to increase size to 6 failed: error creating instance: RequestLaunchTemplateData: LaunchTemplateNotPermitted: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
status code: 403, request id: abcdefg-1234
Caused by: iam:PassRole denied for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodNodeRole
```

sre-carol: that explains it. autoscaler is healthy but IAM prevents new instances. is this recent? Did anyone change the launch template or role policies?

infra-ben: I deployed a minor launch-template rotation earlier today to pick up a kernel patch. It included a new instance profile reference because we split roles, but perms for autoscaler/passrole should still be intact. I'll diff the LT now.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: rollout gpu-pool-3 launch-template v7 -> v8 at 2026-03-15T19:40:02Z (initiator: infra-ben).

oncall-alice: copy that. timeline matches. cluster tried to scale right after the rollout and got denied.

eng-runtime-eve: If PassRole is missing, cluster-autoscaler (and ASG) can't launch instances with the new profile. We should either revert to v7 or temporarily bump permissions to allow PassRole for the autoscaler instance role. Which is lower blast radius?

infra-ben: Reverting LT is quick but some nodes already running v8. I'd prefer to add iam:PassRole to the autopolicy for the autoscaler service principal while we validate v8. Doing that now.

ops-bot: IAM change requested: add iam:PassRole to role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodAutoscalerSvc (request id 9a8b7c).

infra-ben: applied permissive patch to autoscaler service role. requesting immediate scale retry.

oncall-alice: telling cluster-autoscaler to retry via annotation. ```
kubectl annotate deployment cluster-autoscaler autoscaler.kubernetes.io/retry="now" -n kube-system
```

noncall-alice: cluster-autoscaler logs now show progress, provisioning new instance i-0f12345.

pagerbot: Customer-impact update: Affected customers in us-west-2 - throughput degraded, some requests queued >30s, a subset seeing 503 errors. Current estimated affected sessions: ~420 (best-effort).

cust-succ-dmitri: heads-up: I already saw two customers open tickets about higher latencies. Please keep me posted on ETA to restore capacity so I can update them.

sre-carol: new node joined and joined kube cluster but pods are pending. Saw rapid crashloop on node-init: taint propagation mismatch from new LT. logs: ```
/var/log/cloud-init.log: error: unable to apply kubelet taints: unknown taint key "redwood/zone"
```

eng-runtime-eve: that suggests the v8 launch template introduced a node label/taint schema we don't handle in our admission. The scheduler is refusing to place GPU pods because taints don't match tolerations. We need to either accept the taints (add tolerations) or remove the taint at node level. Which pods are pending?

noncall-alice: listing pending pods: ```
kubectl get pods -n ml-serving -o wide | grep Pending
ml-model-a-5f9d7   0/1   Pending   0   2m   gpu-pool-3
ml-model-b-77c3f   0/1   Pending   0   2m   gpu-pool-3
```

sre-carol: To quickly restore capacity, I'll remove the taint from the node so existing workloads can land, while infra fixes LT to be compatible. Applying: ```
kubectl taint nodes i-0f12345 redwood/zone- || true
```

infra-ben: hold on — need to confirm security implications. The taint was added intentionally to route specific GPU SKUs to a limited pool for pricing. Removing might allow workload mismatch. Is short-term risk acceptable?

eng-runtime-eve: short-term: ok — workloads will likely run fine even if GPU SKU differs; degrade performance is possible but preferable to customer-impact. Approve temporary removal for 30m and then re-schedule.

infra-ben: ok removing taint for remediation window. Doing it now.

noncall-alice: pods are scheduling. ml-model-a -> Running. ml-model-b -> Running. Latency dropping.

pagerbot: Update: queue length down from +820 to +120 in 12m. 503 errors reduced by ~85%. Continuing mitigation.

cust-succ-dmitri: excellent, I'll update customers: partial restoration, monitoring. Thanks team.

sre-carol: Now we need durable fix: either rollback launch-template v8 to v7, or patch our admission/tolerations and IAM policies. Which path?

infra-ben: I want to roll forward with v8 because it contains sec kernel fix. Plan: 1) Add iam:PassRole permanently to autoscaler role via PR (audit ping). 2) Update node-init scripts in v8 to use taint key redwood/sku instead of redwood/zone to match scheduler tolerations (or update scheduler tolerations). 3) We'll cut v8.1 with corrected taint key and redeploy.

eng-runtime-eve: also need to add a preflight in the LT rollout pipeline that validates that new taints/labels are accepted by cluster (smoke create node -> check kubelet registration). I'll open a quick PR to add that gate.

infra-ben: creating rollback PR in case v8.1 takes >30m.

ops-bot: PR created: infra/launch-templates#442 - add smoke-check + v8.1 (initiator: infra-ben).

oncall-alice: temporary mitigation summary for handoff: - IAM PassRole patched to autoscaler svc - taint cleared on newly provisioned nodes - manual annotation retriggered scale - queue now mostly drained - monitoring alerts suppressed for 20m while we validate

oncall-alice: handing off to @sre-carol for next shift. please monitor GPU pool saturation and customer error rate in us-west-2.

sre-carol: taking over. I'll keep the runbook open and assign follow-ups. Next steps: verify PR, schedule v8.1 deploy in 20m, roll back if additional issues.

cust-succ-dmitri: ETA note for customers: "We restored capacity by removing temporary taints and patching autoscaler permissions. Engineering is deploying a non-disruptive fix; we'll follow up when we fully validate."

pagerbot: INCIDENT update: Severity reduced to P2 (mitigated) at 2026-03-15T20:12:00Z. Root cause: launch-template rotation introduced an IAM/taint mismatch preventing autoscaler from provisioning compatible GPU nodes.

eng-runtime-eve: follow-up items (created): [1] Add LT preflight checks (PR 443), [2] Harden autoscaler IAM tests in CI (PR 444), [3] Add alert annotation for LaunchTemplate rollouts to pause autoscaler during LT change (PR 445).

infra-ben: will file an internal postmortem and include timeline and customer impact numbers.

sre-carol: noted - I'll schedule oncall retro and add this incident to monthly pager review.

cust-succ-dmitri: closing customer communications loop after final validation.

oncall-alice: thanks all, great quick coordination. :teamwork:
